name: Mr. Gallup
role: New York lawyer visiting the Bad Lands, July 1884
bio: Mr. Gallup of the New York law firm Johnson, Gallup & Hurry came through from the Black Hills in July 1884 and stayed at Wadsworth's ranch during calf branding. The paper reported he left convinced the Bad Lands would become one of the country's great cattle sections.

moments.label: Left convinced of the Bad Lands' cattle future

mentions: Mr. Gallup, of the New York law firm of Johnson, Gallup & Hurry, came through from the Hills with the pilgrims and is now at Wadsworth's ranch with Rassie Deffebach and Billy Brewe…
